page.content:
Cross-street of grindhouses, then restoration, that still names a Broadway musical.

How 42nd Street connects

  • Location: Broadway theatre district — 42nd Street cuts through the Broadway theatre district.
  • Work: 42nd Street (musical) — The musical 42nd Street takes its name and myth from the Midtown street.

What is 42nd Street?

42nd Street is the Midtown crosstown that ran from dime museums and movie grinders to a restored row of Broadway houses, and that gave its name to the 1933 film and the later stage musical.

Key threads lead to Broadway theatre district and 42nd Street (musical).
